events.factual_description: Birdland Theater presents BOUNCIN' WITH BUD: Bud Powell Birthday Celebration from Friday, October 2 through Sunday, October 4, 2026. Birdland lists two sets per night at 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM, with Tardo Hammer on piano, Pasquale Grasso on guitar, Lonnie Plaxico on bass, and Steve Smith on drums. The venue lists $35.46-$45.76 for the performances. Birdland's event page routes each set through its own authorized TicketWeb purchase link. The engagement is part of Steve Smith's multi-program Birdland residency, and contemporary residency coverage describes this quartet as exploring the music of Bud Powell.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is the instrumentation as much as the tribute: Tardo Hammer's piano and Pasquale Grasso's guitar approach Bud Powell's bebop language from two different harmonic angles, with Lonnie Plaxico and Steve Smith underneath them. That makes this more useful than a generic birthday set—the repertoire is a reason to hear four strong individual voices negotiate a very specific jazz vocabulary in real time.
en.trip_verdict: If a New York evening naturally falls on October 2–4, pick the set that fits and go. With six chances across three nights, I would use the flexibility rather than organize a DMV-to-New York trip around this engagement alone.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho está tanto en la instrumentación como en el homenaje: el piano de Tardo Hammer y la guitarra de Pasquale Grasso atacan el lenguaje bebop de Bud Powell desde dos ángulos armónicos distintos, con Lonnie Plaxico y Steve Smith sosteniendo el pulso. Eso lo vuelve más interesante que una celebración genérica: el repertorio sirve para escuchar a cuatro voces muy definidas negociar en tiempo real un vocabulario de jazz sumamente específico.
es.trip_verdict: Si una noche en Nueva York cae naturalmente entre el 2 y el 4 de octubre, escogería el set que mejor acomode e iría. Con seis oportunidades en tres noches, aprovecharía esa flexibilidad en lugar de organizar un viaje DMV–Nueva York únicamente alrededor de esta fecha.
